using namespace std;

static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;

static inline int highestOneBit(int x) {
    if (x <= 0) return 0;
    return 1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(x));
}

class IntList {
public:
    int *data;
    int capacity;
    int size;

    IntList() : data(new int[3]), capacity(3), size(0) {}

    ~IntList() { delete[] data; }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }
    int size() const { return size; }

    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= capacity) {
            int newCap = (capacity << 1) + 1;
            int *newData = new int[newCap];
            memcpy(newData, data, size * sizeof(int));
            delete[] data;
            data = newData;
            capacity = newCap;
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        expand();
        memmove(data + index + 1, data + index, (size - index) * sizeof(int));
        data[index] = value;
        ++size;
    }

    int deleteAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int value = data[index];
        memmove(data + index, data + index + 1, (size - index - 1) * sizeof(int));
        --size;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        data[size++] = value;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) throw logic_error("No such element");
        return data[--size];
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        memmove(data + 1, data, size * sizeof(int));
        data[0] = value;
        ++size;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) throw logic_error("No such element");
        int value = data[0];
        memmove(data, data + 1, (size - 1) * sizeof(int));
        --size;
        return value;
    }

    void clear() { size = 0; }
};

class IntIntMap {
public:
    int *data;
    int capacity;
    int size;

    IntIntMap() : data(new int[4]), capacity(4), size(0) {
        data[0] = EMPTY;
        data[2] = EMPTY;
    }

    ~IntIntMap() { delete[] data; }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }
    int size() const { return size; }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i += 2) data[i] = EMPTY;
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int h = key * 1000000007;
        h ^= h >> 16;
        h ^= h >> 24;
        return h;
    }

    bool have(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return true;
            if (cur == EMPTY) return false;
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return data[i + 1];
            if (cur == EMPTY) return default_;
        }
    }

    static int* resize(int oldData[], int oldCapacity, int newCapacity) {
        int *newData = new int[newCapacity];
        for (int i = 0; i < newCapacity; i += 2) newData[i] = EMPTY;
        int newMask = newCapacity - 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < oldCapacity; i += 2) {
            int cur = oldData[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) continue;
            for (int j = hash(cur) & newMask;; j = (j - 1) & newMask) {
                if (newData[j] == EMPTY) {
                    newData[j] = cur;
                    newData[j + 1] = oldData[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return newData;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int *curData = data;
        int cap = capacity;
        int mask = cap - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = curData[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                curData[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            }
            if (cur == EMPTY) {
                curData[i] = key;
                curData[i + 1] = value;
                ++size;
                if (size > cap >> 2) {
                    int newCap = cap << 1;
                    data = resize(curData, cap, newCap);
                    capacity = newCap;
                    delete[] curData;
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void deleteKey(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int *curData = data;
        int cap = capacity;
        int mask = cap - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = curData[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                for (int j = i;;) {
                    cur = curData[j = (j - 1) & mask];
                    if (cur == EMPTY) {
                        curData[i] = EMPTY;
                        --size;
                        return;
                    }
                    int k = hash(cur) & mask;
                    if ((k >= i) ^ (k < j) ^ (i < j)) {
                        curData[i] = cur;
                        curData[i + 1] = curData[j + 1];
                        i = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (cur == EMPTY) return;
        }
    }

    void expand(int newCapacity) {
        int *curData = data;
        int oldCap = capacity;
        if (oldCap >> 2 < newCapacity) {
            int newCap = highestOneBit(newCapacity - 1) << 3;
            if (newCap < 4) newCap = 4;
            data = resize(curData, oldCap, newCap);
            capacity = newCap;
            delete[] curData;
        }
    }

    void shrink() {
        int *curData = data;
        int oldCap = capacity;
        if (oldCap > 4 && oldCap >> 3 >= size) {
            int newCap = max(highestOneBit(size - 1) << 3, 4);
            data = resize(curData, oldCap, newCap);
            capacity = newCap;
            delete[] curData;
        }
    }

    struct Iterator {

        int position;

        // We'll adjust implementation in the map method.

        int getValue() const { return data[position + 1]; }
        void advance() {
            do {
                position += 2;
            } while (position < (int)(sizeof(data)/sizeof(int)) && data[position] == EMPTY);
        }
    };

    Iterator iterator() {
        return Iterator(data); // Hmm, need capacity. We'll modify.
    }
};

static vector<IntList*> freeLists;

static IntList* takeList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return new IntList();
    } else {
        IntList *res = freeLists.back();
        freeLists.pop_back();
        return res;
    }
}

static void putList(IntList *list) {
    list->clear();
    freeLists.push_back(list);
}

static int n, m;

static IntList* solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList *res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res = takeList();
        res->push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res->push(n - from);
            res->push(from - n);
        }
        res->push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res->push(n - from);
            res->push(from);
        }
        res->push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList *a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList *b = solve(mid, to);
        res = takeList();
        int aSize = a->size, bSize = b->size;
        int *aData = a->data, *bData = b->data;
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = i == 0 ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0, r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[m] <= aFrom) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res->push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res->push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res->push(bTo);
        }
        putList(a);
        putList(b);
    }
    return res;
}

static void solve() {
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> s >> t;
    s--;
    for (int ct = (int)(t % n); ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList *cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve->size;
        int *csData = cycleSolve->data;
        IntList *cycleList = takeList();
        IntIntMap *cycleMap = new IntIntMap();
        for (int it = 0; ; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap->get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList->get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList->push(s);
            cycleMap->set(s, it);
            int l = 0, r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m] <= s) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
        delete cycleMap;
        putList(cycleList);
        putList(cycleSolve);
    }
    cout << s + 1 << endl;
}

int main() {
    try {
        solve();
    } catch (exception &e) {
        cerr << e.what() << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
